title: The education pack: programmes, students, admissions, fees (job CR)
description: Generated from services/ai-api/app/education/models.py by `make contracts`. Requests forbid unknown properties: a date of birth, a photograph, an address, an identity number, a note or an amount a model made can never be sent.

AdmissionIn.description: Start an enquiry for a parent or guardian: an existing contact (`contact_id`), or a new one (`guardian_name` and `guardian_phone`; the number is the parent's, never a child's). No child is stored until admitted.
AdmissionIn.title: AdmissionIn

AdmitIn.description: Admitted: the enquiry becomes a student (the guardian is the enquiry's contact; an adult student IS that contact) and, with `plan_id`, the fee plan is assigned. Both ids are the caller's, so a retry is safe.
AdmitIn.title: AdmitIn

AgeingOut.description: What is still open, by how old the invoice is (days since the invoice date).
AgeingOut.title: AgeingOut

AudienceIn.description: Who an announcement goes to: every guardian of the students in a section/batch (`group`), a programme, or the whole institution (`all`), with the date of the event, exam or holiday. One message per guardian.
AudienceIn.title: AudienceIn

ConcessionIn.description: An amount, or a percentage (1 to 100) of what was charged to the student; a reason code. The Owner or an Admin, with a second factor.
ConcessionIn.title: ConcessionIn

FeePlanIn.description:
A plan for a programme (and optionally one group) in an academic year: the heads, the instalments with their due dates, and an optional late-fee rule. `fixed` = one amount per late instalment; `per_day` =
that amount for each day late, never above `late_fee_cap_paise`. A plan that a student has been assigned cannot change (make a new plan).
FeePlanIn.title: FeePlanIn

FeeReceiptOut.description: A fee receipt, ready to print or to send: the number, the date, the amount, the method, who paid (the guardian), for whom (the student), what it was set against and the balance after it.
FeeReceiptOut.title: FeeReceiptOut

OverdueAgeingOut.description: What is still open, by how many days it is past its DUE date (`not_due` is not yet due).
OverdueAgeingOut.title: OverdueAgeingOut

ProfileIn.description:
The institution: its type, the month its academic year starts, up to six terms, the languages parents use, and (optional, the Owner's, with a second factor) how many months after a student leaves their record
is erased automatically (null = never automatically; the lawyer sets the number).
ProfileIn.title: ProfileIn

ProgrammeIn.description: A class set (Class 1 to 12) or a course (B.Com). `group_kind` says what it is divided into: sections (A, B), years, semesters, batches (with a timing) or `none`. The kind never changes.
ProgrammeIn.title: ProgrammeIn

ReportOut.description: Figures, typed tables and series by day. `from` and `to` are the India days the figures cover (`as_of` the day they are as of).
ReportOut.title: ReportOut

StudentIn.description:
A student. `contact_id` is the ADULT we write to: the guardian of a child, or the adult student themself (`is_adult` true, no label). A child needs a `child_label` (a first name or initials; no digits). The
contact, the kind and the id never change.
StudentIn.title: StudentIn
